svg.title: Four Gates Before a Hybrid or Wrap Closes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-hybrid-underwriting-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Four Gates Before a Hybrid or Wrap Closes; subtitle: Lien coverage, real arrears, active income, borrower pre-screen; caption: Kill-or-proceed gates practitioners apply when structuring subject-to plus seller-note hybrids and carrying wrap paper.; assumptions note: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each rule is stated by the attributed practitioner, and the $5,000 buffer is Pace Morby's reported legal-fee gap.; note: Sources: Scott Horne's Owner Finance Network (it6vSh38OhY), Pace Morby (t7aFESM6V_k, rQCg4GFRLAI), Fusion Notes (JAyoDBTIEIE).; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Is the wrap balance at least equal to every underlying lien, including modification, down-payment assistance and 0% HUD liens?; pass next: G2; fail action: Restructure; the position can drift upside down (Scott Horne).; gate: G2; question: Are payoff and arrears confirmed with the lender, plus about $5,000 for legal fees?; pass next: G3; fail action: Rebuild the entry fee; the title company is not the bank (Pace Morby).; gate: G3; question: If using the Morby Method, is active income coming in on the deal?; pass next: G4; fail action: Kill the Morby Method; people take the cash out and bail (Pace Morby).; gate: G4; question: Does a five-minute pre-screen show no bankruptcies, foreclosures or missed mortgage payments in the last 12 months?; pass next: Carry the paper and close; fail action: Decline to carry paper on the wrap (Fusion Notes).

text.title: Four Gates Before a Hybrid or Wrap Closes
text.tspan: Four Gates Before a Hybrid or Wrap Closes

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Is the wrap balance at least equal to every underlying lien, including modification, down-payment assistance and 0% HUD liens?; pass next: G2; fail action: Restructure; the position can drift upside down (Scott Horne).

gate: G2; question: Are payoff and arrears confirmed with the lender, plus about $5,000 for legal fees?; pass next: G3; fail action: Rebuild the entry fee; the title company is not the bank (Pace Morby).
gate: G3; question: If using the Morby Method, is active income coming in on the deal?; pass next: G4; fail action: Kill the Morby Method; people take the cash out and bail (Pace Morby).

gate: G4; question: Does a five-minute pre-screen show no bankruptcies, foreclosures or missed mortgage payments in the last 12 months?; pass next: Carry the paper and close; fail action: Decline to carry paper on the wrap (Fusion Notes).

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each rule is stated by the attributed practitioner, and the $5,000 buffer is Pace Morby's reported legal-fee gap.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each rule is stated by the attributed practitioner, and the $5,000 buffer is Pace
